request: LitClaude GitHub 한국어 페이지에 쓸 새 모션 필름을 lit-typographic-motion으로 다시 만들고, Pretendard로 조판해서 더 아름답게. 당신은 열정 넘치는 프로 모션 그래픽 디자이너입니다.
pathReason: The film has to show drawn things (three checks that go from unlit to failing to passing, a small web page that gets clicked, a record handed to a new session, a flame), so the visuals are authored as a page and captured frame by frame; type alone cannot show them.
idea: Ending a request with lit ignites a giant dim word, and that same light then travels through one small job as it is pinned, fails first, gets checked on a real page and is handed to the next session, until the whole room is lit.
audience: Developers who already use Claude Code and lose the thread between sessions.
channel: The top of a GitHub README, autoplaying muted as an animated preview, with the MP4 one click away.
formatReason: A README column and the MP4 link both show a landscape frame, and the giant word, the small page and the record card read best wide.

beats.purpose: Hook: the ask ignites the word
beats.onScreen: Centered on near-black: the line End any request with, then a giant dim word lit with one small ember on the dot of the i, then a monospace prompt line about a to-do list that types out and ends in lit. When the typed lit lands, the ember flares and the three letters of the giant word turn orange one after another under a warm glow.
beats.motion: The prompt types at a steady pace with a blinking caret. The ember pulses once, the orange runs l, i, t with a light sweep, and the glow settles into a readable hold before the word scales away.
beats.sound: a slow rise under the typing that swells into the hand-off to the goal

beats.purpose: Step one: the goal is pinned
beats.onScreen: The giant orange word shrinks into a small orange lit mark at the top left. The headline Pin the goal. sits left with goal. in orange. On the right three unlit rows appear: an empty ring beside add, complete and delete.
beats.motion: Scale hand-off: the giant word flies to the corner while the headline lines rise out of a mask and the rows slide in on a stagger.
beats.sound: a soft hit as the giant word lands in the corner

beats.purpose: Step two: the checks fail first
beats.onScreen: Headline Fail first. with first. in orange. Each ring on the right turns orange and an orange cross draws inside it, one row after the other.
beats.motion: The headline swaps through the mask. The three crosses draw with a stroke on a stagger.
beats.sound: a hit on the cut, the crosses land on the pulse

beats.purpose: Step three: the real page is checked
beats.onScreen: Headline Check the real page. with real page. in orange. The three rows shrink into a strip of chips at the bottom right while a cream to-do page rises above them. A cursor clicks Add, the checkbox and the delete cross, and each chip turns its cross into a cream tick.
beats.motion: The rows scale down into chips, the page reveals from below, the cursor glides between targets with a click ring at each, and each cross morphs to a tick.
beats.sound: a hit on the cut, then a swell under the clicks into the handoff

beats.purpose: Step four: the record is handed on
beats.onScreen: Headline Hand it on. with on. in orange. The three ticks fly into a small record card that lists the goal, what was checked and the next step. An orange spark travels down a drawn line into a fresh terminal that types Read the handoff.
beats.motion: The ticks travel to their places in the card, the spark follows a stroke, and the new terminal wipes in and types.
beats.sound: a hit on the cut, a swell as the spark travels toward the flame

beats.onScreen: The spark grows into a large flame on the right while the room brightens. Headline Keep the work lit. with lit. in orange, the line about planning, building and checking in Claude Code, the install command in monospace, and a status row with a small flame under the flame.
beats.motion: The card and terminal collapse into the spark, the flame springs up and flickers gently, the glow warms the frame, and the tagline and command settle in.
beats.sound: a hit on the cut, then a resolving cadence over the last lines

subject.name: LitClaude
specifics: a Claude Code plugin that plans, builds and checks work
pins a goal, writes the failing checks first and checks the real page
leaves a record in the project that the next session reads
its status row carries a flame and the ignition mark

typePlan.hierarchy: Pretendard 700 for the giant word and the headlines (one orange accent word each), Pretendard 400 for the small lead line and the tagline, and MesloLGS NF only for what a terminal or a record would print. Hierarchy comes from size, colour, position and motion; no other weight is requested and nothing is tracked or condensed while it moves.

palette.role: type and the page, the cream of the armor
the accent: lit, failing and the flame

sound.plan: A clear, airy bed at a walking tempo, with a rise before each hand-off, a hit on each of the five cuts and a resolving cadence on the last lines.

inventions: The demo job: a to-do list in one HTML file (taken from the README's own quick start) with its three checks add, complete and delete.
The example record contents: the goal, the checked list and the next step 'keyboard shortcuts'.
The second session's prompt 'Read the handoff.', which follows the README's advice to ask Claude to read the handoff file.
All copy lines and every drawn object: the terminal lines, the page, the record card and the status row. The Korean lines follow the wording of the Korean README.
ambition: A quiet, large-type reel where one idea runs the film: a giant word ignites and its light is handed from beat to beat by match cuts and scale hand-offs (word to corner mark, rows to chips, ticks to record, spark to flame) instead of cards, with one accent word per headline, long whitespace, a fast entry, a deliberate ease and a readable hold, and a first frame that is already a poster.
